summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the six rod groups, their proportions and conditions, their assignments, and the shepherd’s rejoicing without introducing repentance or salvation conditions. The notes distinguish editorial supplements from preserved text, disclose the reported shorter alternatives, and retain the working readings without conflating witnesses. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied source and disclosure of the supplied comparison reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify historical editions, or constitute exhaustive collation.
